value.rationale: A sharp necessary-and-sufficient condition that decides divisibility uniformly over all finite quantum channels and reset states is structurally valuable, with constructive positive intertwiners and a dimension-explicit obstruction to each late hazard decrease. It resolves the precise boundary between reset age distributions that universally preserve CP-divisibility and those that do not.

limitations: No claims for hazards 0 or 1, fixed-system necessity, Heisenberg composition, or process-tensor Markovianity. Full primary supplement access incomplete; separate from accepted mathematical proof.
